page.overview:
What is Coco 2?

Coco 2 is an upcoming Pixar film. It is a sequel to the 2017 film Coco. At the 2026 D23 Expo, it was announced that Coco 2 will be released in November 2029. Many people have therefore reported it will take the November 21, 2029 spot reserved by Disney for a Pixar film. It will be Pixar's thirty-fifth feature film.

Three years after Miguel Rivera risked everything to bring harmony back to his family, the teenager has been filling the streets of Santa Cecilia with his music. But on the eve of an important audition, Miguel's dreams are threatened when Ernesto de la Cruz - the fallen idol who won't stay forgotten - returns for a vengeful encore. Miguel travels back to the Land of the Dead to reclaim the one thing he cannot live without, and learns that this time it will take more than a song to save what matters most.

The film was announced on Pixar's social media feeds on March 20, 2025. According to a Wall Street Journal article, it is scheduled to be released in 2029.

At the 2026 D23 Expo in Anaheim, California, Benjamin Bratt announced that Ernesto de la Cruz would return in the movie. It was also announced that the film would be released in November of 2029.
